rows.north_eastern_council_secretariat_nec_se: Deputy Adviser (Irrigation, Flood Control and Water Management)
Level 12 (Rs.78800 - 209200 ) of Pay Matrix of 7th CPC

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or institute, and ten years' experience in hydrology, planning, investigation, design or construction and execution of water resources development projects; officer holding an analogous post on regular basis, or with five years' regular service in Level-11 (Rs.67700-208700/-)
Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications)
Director (Administration), North Eastern Council Secretariat, Nongrim Hills, Shillong, 793003

content_sections.heading: NEC Secretariat Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. ADMN-12011/1/2024-ADMN gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NEC Secretariat notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or institute; ten years' experience in the field of hydrology or planning or investigation or design or construction and execution of water resources development projects Experience: Ten years' experience in the field of hydrology or planning or investigation or design or construction and execution of water resources development projects Age limit: Maximum 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications) Other conditions: Officers of Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories, public sector undertakings, Universities, recognised research institutions or statutory or autonomous organizations Officers under Central/State Governments are eligible only for Absorption; candidates of non-Government Organizations only for Short Term Contract

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Deputation (including short term contract) Pay and other terms regulated by DOPT O&M No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dt.17.06.2010 as amended

content_sections.heading: How Will NEC Secretariat Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Curriculum Vitae supported by documents assessed by the Selection Committee Curriculum Vitae duly supported by documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Application in prescribed format (Annexure-II) completed, signed and countersigned by the Cadre/Appointing authority Attested copies of ACRs for the last 5 years, attested on each page with seal by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary to the Government of India Integrity Certificate Vigilance Clearance Major or minor penalty certificate for the last 10 years of service Certificate that particulars furnished are verified and correct as per service records Cadre clearance certificate Self attested copies of educational certificates

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Cadre authorities/Heads of Departments are requested to forward applications of eligible and willing candidates whose services can be spared immediately

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NEC Secretariat Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NEC Secretariat Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Deputy Adviser (Irrigation, Flood Control and Water Management).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NEC Secretariat Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II (Curriculum Vitae Proforma), to be downloaded from the NEC website http://necouncil.gov.in) and send it to Director (Administration), North Eastern Council Secretariat, Nongrim Hills, Shillong, 793003, by post, to reach by 5 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level 12 (Rs.78800 - 209200 ) of Pay Matrix of 7th CPC.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or institute, and ten years' experience in hydrology, planning, investigation, design or construction and execution of water resources development projects; officer holding an analogous post on regular basis, or with five years' regular service in Level-11 (Rs.67700-208700/-).

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Officers of Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories, public sector undertakings, Universities, recognised research institutions or statutory or autonomous organizations. Officers under Central/State Governments are eligible only for Absorption; candidates of non-Government Organizations only for Short Term Contract.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Curriculum Vitae supported by documents assessed by the Selection Committee. Curriculum Vitae duly supported by documents will be assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (including short term contract). Pay and other terms regulated by DOPT O&M No.6/8/2009-Estt.(Pay-II) dt.17.06.2010 as amended.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shillong.
